conn.downHint: Open Ciclo Assist to use this panel.

actions.selectionHint: Opens the Sincronizar window on this project's bin list. One bin becomes one source.

result.sent: Done — Sincronizar opened the bin list.

panel.title: Sincronizar
panel.cacheHint: Waveforms and metadata already read. Clearing loses no work — Sincronizar re-reads the files next time.
panel.logsHint: Opens the logs folder in Finder.
panel.busy: Sincronizar is syncing — this action waits for the engine to finish.
panel.settingsPathHint: Changing the cache LOCATION is still done in Sincronizar's Settings: picking a folder needs a system dialog, which would appear behind Media Composer.
panel.dropUnknown: I didn't recognise what was dropped here. Drag clips from a Media Composer bin.
panel.dropUnreadable: Media Composer sent something I couldn't read.
panel.dropNoMasters: That isn't camera footage: you dropped {{what}}. Drag the source clips (masterclips) from the bin.
panel.dropNoFiles: The dragged clips weren't found on disk.
panel.missing: {{n}} clip(s) from the selection were not found on disk.
panel.needTwo: Add at least 2 sources to sync.
panel.engineBusy: The engine is busy with another job.
panel.duplicates: {{n}} clip(s) were already in the list and were skipped.
panel.nothingNew: Nothing new in the selection — every clip is already in the list.
panel.colResizeHint: Drag to resize; double-click to reset
panel.scenePresumedHint: Presumed from the shape of this day's names (number-number), with no label. Please check.

conflict.sobreposto: Overlapping TC: a clip starts before the previous one ends.
conflict.zerado: More than one clip with zeroed TC in this card.
conflict.continuo: Continuous TC: a clip starts on the frame right after the previous one ends. Usually wrong, but can be a camera splitting long sessions, and then it is fine.

panel.dropOnBox: Drop on one of the boxes: Add Camera or Add Production Sound.
panel.askSeparate: We found separate video and audio. Bring them in as two sources?
panel.timelineFromProject: In Media Composer the timeline inherits from the project.
panel.timelineInvalid: Under Other, enter the timeline width and height.

drop.wrongTab: Nothing to drop here — switch to the {{tab}} tab.
drop.tryRename: That is {{what}} — drop it on the {{tab}} tab to change the name.
drop.trySubclip: That is a timeline — drop it on the {{tab}} tab to create subclips.
drop.audioInCamera: This is audio only. Drop it on Add Production Sound.
drop.videoInSound: This has picture. Drop it on Add Camera.

subclip.emptyState: Drop the synced timeline here. Sincronizar creates one subclip per take, trimmed to where picture and sound overlap.
subclip.onePerDrop: Drop one timeline at a time.
subclip.noBin: Media Composer could not find that timeline's bin. Is it still open?
subclip.nothing: No takes found in that bin.
subclip.fromSource: the pattern did not apply to this take — it kept its source name
subclip.notOpened: the bins are on disk, but Media Composer did not open them
subclip.cleared: List cleared. Drop the timeline again to start over.
subclip.prEmpty: Drag a synced sequence from the Premiere bin here, or read the sequence open in the timeline. Each take (the camera with its production sound) becomes a merged clip.
subclip.prNoSequence: There is no sequence open in the Premiere timeline.
subclip.prOnlySequence: Drag a SEQUENCE from the bin (the merged clips come from its takes).
subclip.prImporting: importing the merged clips into Premiere…
subclip.prLoose: {{n}} clip(s) without production sound came in as subclips in the same bin.
subclip.prLooseFailed: Could not create the subclip of: {{nomes}}.
subclip.prNothing: No new merged clips: this sequence's were already in the project.

rename.dropHere: Drop items from the bin here — clip, subclip, sequence or effect. All of them count.
rename.patternNote: Type % to see this bin's fields and confirm with Enter — the tag closes itself, like %{cena}, and can sit against any literal. %% writes a literal %.
rename.readWithIgnored: {{n}} item(s) read. {{ign}} were left out — they belong to another bin.
rename.nothing: Nothing recognized in what was dropped.
rename.unknownField: {{what}} does not exist. Pick a field from the list above.
rename.wouldBeEmpty: One item would end up with NO NAME. Nothing will be renamed.
rename.keepsName: No value for the pattern — this item keeps its current name
rename.notConfirmed: the bin did not confirm the save: select it in Media Composer and save (Ctrl+S)
rename.diverged: {{n}} were left alone — someone renamed them by hand afterwards
rename.undoLimits: To restore specific clips, drop them in and use %nome_original in the pattern. Undo lives on this machine and does not travel with the project.
rename.prHint: Select the clips in the Premiere bin and drag them here, or read the selection.
rename.prSaveHint: Premiere does not save by itself: save the project to keep the names.
rename.prUndoInfo: The project's last batch of names goes back to what it was — anything renamed afterwards stays as it is.
rename.prDiverged: {{n}} were not touched: someone renamed them afterwards.

app.buildNoScale: {{n}} clip(s) were not fitted to the timeline: use Scale to Frame Size.
app.noProgramHint: Open Premiere or Media Composer with a project. Sincronizar detects it on its own.
app.noSelection: Nothing selected in the Premiere bin, or only items without media (sequence, still, adjustment layer).
app.premiereOffline: Premiere is not connected. Install the integration in the ⚙ tab and open Premiere after it.
app.importing: importing what the project is missing into the bin…
app.built: Done: sequence “{{name}}” in the Premiere bin ({{placed}} video clips, {{audio}} audio).
app.buildMissing: {{n}} clip(s) were not found in the project.
app.pinOn: Pinned on top — click to release
app.pinOff: Keep this window on top of the others
app.installPremiereHint: Installs the invisible bridge (no window) that lets Sincronizar talk to Premiere. Close and reopen Premiere afterwards.
app.installed: Integration installed. Close and reopen Premiere.
app.dropBin: The sidebar bin does not carry its clips. Open the bin and drag the clips from inside it.
app.dropOffline: No editing app connected to receive the drop.
app.reviewComment: {{name}} was cut by the next take of the same camera, which stayed on its timecode (slow motion?). Check the cut.
app.reviewCount: {{n}} clip(s) cut by the next take: see the “Sincronizar: review cut” markers.
app.jobReceived: Request from Ciclo Assist: building “{{name}}” in Premiere…
app.mergedImporting: Request from Ciclo Assist: importing the merged clips “{{name}}” into Premiere…
app.mergedNothing: The merged clips were already in the project: nothing new imported.
